description: eSIMs with a real carrier phone number (calls, texts and data), with prices. Optional country: US, VN, AU, MN, MV, EU (Europe) or GLOBAL. Each plan has an order_url for the person. Non-refundable once bought. Prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria; pass currency to choose.

country.description: Optional: US, VN, AU, MN, MV, EU or GLOBAL.

currency.description: Optional: USD or NGN. By default prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira inside Nigeria, from where the request comes from.
